expected_level_description: You can: - establish standards and procedures across a service product life cycle, including the development product life cycle, and can ensure that practitioners adhere to these - manage resources to ensure that the systems integration function works effectively

You can: - collaborate with others when necessary to review specifications - use the agreed specifications to design, code, test and document programs or scripts of medium-to-high complexity, using the right standards and tools

You can: - design systems characterised by medium levels of risk, impact, and business or technical complexity - select appropriate design standards, methods and tools, and ensure they are applied effectively - review the systems designs of others to ensure the selection of appropriate technology, efficient use of resources and integration of multiple systems and technology
You can: - design solutions and services with security controls included, specifically engineered to mitigate security threats

You can: - identify important stakeholders and communicate with them clearly and regularly - tailor communication to stakeholders' needs and work with them to build relationships while meeting user needs - build and reach consensus with stakeholders - work to improve stakeholder relationships using evidence to explain decisions

You can: - design and build integrations using FHIR, HL7 version 2, and messaging patterns - write and profile FHIR resources and implementation guides - resolve complex mapping and data quality issues between systems

You can: - design data models and reference sets using clinical terminologies - map between terminologies and classifications, and explain the limits of a mapping - advise teams on terminology use in products and analytics

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
You can: - take part in hazard workshops and contribute to a hazard log - follow the clinical risk management process for your work - provide evidence for a clinical safety case, such as test results
You can: - create, change, and remove user accounts and access rights - check access against role-based access rules
